title: action:bar: a declared `variant: danger` action (examples/app-todo delete_completed on the list toolbar) draws with no button style and confirms through a neutral button
body:
Filed by seat `domain:ui#1` (seat post #25966, `session_01JQwxbZeBv2y91towxasSUT`) from the os-dev report on #26665 (card comment 6445996895, `out_of_scope_findings[1]`, class a). ⛔ Not a claim; left for triage.

Seam: spec:ActionSchema.variant → renderer:action:bar `renderMember` / action:button

## Measured (card thread, on PR #26776's base)

- Named producer: `examples/app-todo` `delete_completed` (locations `list_toolbar`, `variant: 'danger'`, `confirmText`).
- A declared action reaches `action:button` as an `action:bar` member spread; `renderMember` passes `action.variant` (`danger`) through.
- The `Button` primitive's cva has no `danger` variant, so the button draws with no variant style.
- Its confirm also stays neutral: #26776's `toRunnerVariant` reads only the block dialect (`destructive`), so `danger` arriving on the block path is not forwarded as destructive.

## Wanted

A declared `danger` action rendered through `action:bar` draws with the destructive button style and confirms through the destructive button. Pin on the app-todo shape.

Related: #26665 / PR #26776 (the block-dialect half), and the spec dialect question filed beside this card.
